nodes.question: Why is it important to integrate a broader range of stakeholders in the process of developing sustainable passenger transport systems?
nodes.answer: Integrating a broader range of stakeholders ensures that diverse perspectives and expertise are considered, leading to more effective and inclusive transportation policies.

nodes.question: At what level does this research focus regarding policy integration?
nodes.answer: This research focuses on the operational level of integration, as opposed to the system level.

Likewise, when implementing policies, actors can plan their activities over one speci C problem or over multiple societal challenges (Lyles et al. 2018 ). While most studies tend to focus on the system level interacting effects(e.g. Duguma et al., 2014 ; Berry et al. 2015 ), and speci - cally address policy integration (Di Gregorio et al. 2017 ; Cejudo & Trein 2023 ; Biesbroek, Candel 2020 ), this research focuses on the operational level of integration, where solutions have a physical impact. Notwithstanding these bene its, researchers also admit that integration can imply high transaction costs and may have unintended side effects due to the impossibility of predicting the risks in such a complex multi-sector setting (Bryson et al. 2006 ; M rker et al. 2018 ; Kongsager 2018 ; Metz et al. 2020 ). In addition, De Lo and Patterson ( 2017 p. 93) state that challenges for which causes, effects, and interests are relatively clear, uncontentious, and bound by sector are generally tackled most ef ciently using a sectoral scope.
